author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Stealth Hunter 2

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
On the title screen the host picks the number of players, then starts the mission.
tips: Co-op for up to four players on one shared view; every player has their own keys.
If anyone dies, the team restarts the mission.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Sneak through guarded bases, pick locks and take out guards without raising the alarm. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: up to four players play the campaign together on a shared view, and if anyone dies the team restarts the mission.
